title: missing project/wiki/ is a bare not-found with no create hint
description:
Researcher first-pass.

New pods have no project/wiki/. First `kbs wiki render` is a bare \"wiki page not found\" with no hint to create the folder or a starter index.md.

Product rule: if project/wiki/ is missing, say so and say how to create it (mkdir + a stub index, or `kbs wiki init` if we add one). Do not look like a bad page name.

comments.author: ryan
comments.text: Shipped in Kanbus 0.20.0 via PR #172 (list/search/show/lint/check/init, render path, short issue.key, references()). Closing.
